title: GE CIMPLICITY (Update A)
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW STACK-BASED BUFFER OVERFLOW CWE-121 A function reads a packet to indicate the next packet length. The next packet length is not verified, allowing a buffer overwrite that could lead to an arbitrary remote code execution. --------- Begin Update A Part 3 of 3 -------- CVE-2017-12732 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.8 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:A/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). --------- End Update A Part 3 of 3 -------- RESEARCHER David Atch of CyberX reported the vulnerability to ICS-CERT.
